title: Study of Trabecular Bone Score (TBS) as a Fracture Risk Factor in Chronic Renal Failure
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 1st population: kidney failure patients at stage 4-5, age\> 40 years, non-dialyzed, ungrafted.
* 2nd population: kidney transplant patients, age\> 40, first kidney transplant.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women.
* Incapable adults (tutelage, guardianship, safeguard of justice).
* Persons deprived of liberty.
study_population: Kidney failure patients and kidney transplant patients
